data.summary_en: TextualRL proposes gradient-free RL; judges policies via same-task/context rollout groups, not single-trajectory; Groupwise Policy Critique and Cross-Group Policy Update generate bounded textual patches accepted by held-out validation reward. Six benchmarks: GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-27B average test-accuracy gains of 24.4 and 15.3 percentage points over base models.
